sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的一些领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于11月

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: At the start of the Trump presidency, leaders within ICE, immigration and customs enforcement,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统任期开始时，美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）的领导层

sentences.en: jumped at the chance to give two filmmakers, Christina Clauzzo and Shaul Schwartz, inside access to document the agency's new hardline agenda.
sentences.zh: 抓住机会，让两位电影制作人克里斯蒂娜·克劳佐和沙ul·施瓦茨深入内部，记录该机构的新强硬议程。

sentences.en: Four years later, and with the election approaching,
sentences.zh: 四年后，随着大选临近，

sentences.en: the agency tried to block the release of their film.
sentences.zh: 该机构试图阻止他们电影的上映。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月14日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hi, guys.
sentences.zh: 嗨，伙计们。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We're so grateful for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're going to start.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要开始了。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Christina Anshal, we know that ICE is a notoriously secretive organization.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·安沙尔，我们知道ICE是一个出了名的保密机构。

sentences.en: It is very rare for them to allow journalists or filmmakers access to their operations, but you were able to follow them for nearly three years with a tremendous level of access.
sentences.zh: 他们极少允许记者或电影制作人接触其行动，但你们却能够跟踪他们近三年，拥有极高的采访权限。

sentences.en: So how did you go about getting that access?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们是怎么获得这种权限的呢？

sentences.en: What's the story?
sentences.zh: 有什么故事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I originally started working with ICE almost a decade ago, doing stories about the drug war.
sentences.zh: 是的，我最初开始与ICE合作大约是在十年前，当时是做关于禁毒战争的报道。

sentences.en: And as part of that, I met an ICE spokesman who was at the time a local Arizona spokesman.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，我认识了一位ICE发言人，他当时是亚利桑那州当地的发言人。

sentences.en: As the years kind of progressed, he had moved up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他晋升了。

sentences.en: And actually, during the Obama time, they were not so interested in somebody really taking a deep dive into the agency.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在奥巴马执政时期，他们对有人真正深入调查该机构并没有太大兴趣。

sentences.en: And so I want to recognize the ICE and Border Patrol officers in this room today and to honor their service.
sentences.zh: 因此，我想借此机会感谢今天在场的ICE和边境巡逻队官员，并向他们的服务致敬。

sentences.en: And not just because they unanimously endorsed me for president.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为他们一致支持我竞选总统。

sentences.en: When Trump got elected.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普当选时。

sentences.en: That helps.
sentences.zh: 这有帮助。

sentences.en: But that's not the only reason.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是唯一的理由。

sentences.en: Me and Christina thought maybe ICE would be interested now.
sentences.zh: 我和克里斯蒂娜认为，ICE现在可能会感兴趣。

sentences.en: They seem to be looking at getting a lot of heat.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎承受了很大的压力。

sentences.en: You know, the campaign of Trump was so on the nose on how tough he's going to be on immigration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普的竞选活动非常直白地表明了他在移民问题上会有多强硬。

sentences.en: For too long, your officers and agents haven't been allowed to properly do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，你们的官员和特工一直不被允许正常履行职责。

sentences.en: You know that, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对吧？

sentences.en: Do you know that?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But that's all about to change.
sentences.zh: 但这一切即将改变。

sentences.en: So we approached the spokesman who I had at this point a long relationship with and at that time was already in D.C.
sentences.zh: 于是我们联系了这位发言人，我和他当时已经建立了长期的关系，而且他当时已经在华盛顿了。

sentences.en: And we pitched him.
sentences.zh: 我们向他进行了推介。

sentences.en: We said, listen, we think the agency is going to come under a lot of heat and we would like to see what the men and women of ICE will be up against during this administration.
sentences.zh: 我们说，听着，我们认为该机构将承受巨大压力，我们想看看ICE的男女同仁在本届政府执政期间将面临什么。

sentences.en: And that's how it started.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样开始的。

sentences.en: So kind of counterintuitively, the organization was not interested in having you document them during a relatively low heat moment, the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 所以有点出人意料的是，在奥巴马政府这样一个压力相对较小的时期，该机构并没有兴趣让你去记录他们。

sentences.en: But at its most heated moment, when ICE was under the most scrutiny, they were willing.
sentences.zh: 但在压力最大、ICE受到最多审视的时候，他们却愿意了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that under this administration, they realized very quickly that enforcement policies were changing.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为在本届政府领导下，他们很快意识到执法政策正在改变。

sentences.en: And I'm very happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常高兴。

sentences.en: And you're very happy about it.
sentences.zh: 而你也非常高兴。

sentences.en: From here on out, I'm asking all of you to enforce the laws of the
sentences.zh: 从现在开始，我要求你们所有人都执行

sentences.en: United States of America.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国的法律。

sentences.en: They will be enforced and enforced strongly.
sentences.zh: 这些法律将被执行，而且会强力执行。

sentences.en: And that they were going to be looked at under a different light.
sentences.zh: 并且他们将以一种不同的眼光被审视。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of the officers, at least when we started filming, were feeling that there was a lot that they were up against and
sentences.zh: 我想很多警员，至少在我们开始拍摄时，都觉得他们面临着巨大的压力，

sentences.en: they felt that they wanted to tell their story from the inside.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得想从内部讲述他们的故事。

sentences.en: It's almost like when you're hated, you have to talk about it, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点像当你被人讨厌时，你必须谈论它，对吧？

sentences.en: So you think of an agency that suddenly, on one hand, the gloves are off and they have the support.
sentences.zh: 所以你想想这样一个机构，突然之间，一方面放开手脚，得到了支持。

sentences.en: On the other hand, we need to occupy every airport.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我们需要占领每一个机场。

sentences.en: We need to occupy every border.
sentences.zh: 我们需要占领每一个边境。

sentences.en: We need to occupy every
sentences.zh: 我们需要占领每一个

sentences.en: ICE office until those kids are back with their parents, period.
sentences.zh: ICE办公室，直到那些孩子回到父母身边，就这样。

sentences.en: Everybody were up in arms with them.
sentences.zh: 所有人都对他们群起而攻之。

sentences.en: And then, of course, zero tolerance happened and then they really were in the hot seat.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，零容忍政策出台了，他们真正陷入了风口浪尖。

sentences.en: This is family separation.
sentences.zh: 这就是骨肉分离。

sentences.en: And of course, that kind of gave birth to the abolish ICE movement and a huge outrage that really sparked the debate.
sentences.zh: 当然，这催生了“废除ICE”运动以及引发辩论的巨大愤怒。

sentences.en: And what were the specific terms of the agreement that you had with ICE?
sentences.zh: 你们与ICE达成的协议的具体条款是什么？

sentences.en: Once they said that you could come in, what did they ask, or if anything, in return for granting you this access?
sentences.zh: 一旦他们允许你们进入，作为授予你们这种权限的回报，他们提出了什么要求（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: Yeah, the basics of the agreement was that ICE would see the cuts that we are putting forward and that they would have say in three categories.
sentences.zh: 是的，协议的基本内容是ICE将审阅我们提交的剪辑片段，并且他们在三个类别上有发言权。

sentences.en: Law enforcement sensitivities, which is really, if we are showing kind of how they're doing their work and kind of giving away police secret tactics and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 执法敏感性，这实际上是指如果我们展示了他们的工作方式，可能会泄露警察的秘密战术之类的内容。

sentences.en: It was privacy issues, meaning everybody in the show had to agree and sign releases that they are willing to participate both on DHS and the immigrant side.
sentences.zh: 隐私问题，意味着节目中的每个人都必须同意并签署发布协议，表明他们愿意参与，包括国土安全部（DHS）和移民方面。

sentences.en: And it was factual incorrectness if we were just making a mistake.
sentences.zh: 以及如果我们犯了错误的事实不准确性。

sentences.en: And other than that, the contract stated very clearly that we had the first right amendment to tell our story as we see fit.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，合同非常明确地规定，我们拥有以我们认为合适的方式讲述故事的第一修正案权利。

sentences.en: And really, those were what they were going to be allowed to comment on.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这就是他们被允许发表意见的范围。

sentences.en: So based on that, it sounds like you had real confidence that you would be given free reign to document what you saw and ultimately include it in whatever you produced.
sentences.zh: 所以基于此，听起来你们非常有信心获得完全的自由去记录你们所看到的，并最终把它放进你们制作的任何内容中。

sentences.en: Yeah, overall, we were happily surprised.
sentences.zh: 是的，总的来说，我们感到惊喜。

sentences.en: They said, we're going to get a carte blanche look that they're going to introduce us.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们将获得全权的视角，他们会引见我们。

sentences.en: And once we got to the field in these places that agents were keen on having us ride along, we got to spend endless time and really see them work and
sentences.zh: 一旦我们到达实地，到达特工们热衷于让我们随行的这些地方，我们便有了无尽的时间，真正看到他们工作，

sentences.en: be with them in the field by ourselves and really do the work we were hoping to do.
sentences.zh: 独自和他们待在实地，并真正完成我们希望完成的工作。

sentences.en: So we were really grateful for the agents for being kind of doing their thing and letting us, you know, do our thing, be flies on the wall and document.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的很感激特工们能够各司其职，并让我们做我们该做的事，做墙上的苍蝇并进行记录。

sentences.en: Yeah, please open the door.
sentences.zh: 是的，请开门。

sentences.en: We're not going to yell out in the hallway through a closed door, man.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在过道里隔着紧闭的门大喊大叫，伙计。

sentences.en: That's not how we do business.
sentences.zh: 我们做事不是这样的。

sentences.en: Please open the door so I can talk to you.
sentences.zh: 请开门，好让我跟你谈谈。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that documentation.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这种记录。

sentences.en: What did you see in those first months in terms of exactly how the agency was changing under this new Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 在最初的几个月里，就该机构在新特朗普政府领导下究竟如何变化而言，你们看到了什么？

sentences.en: We saw that the scope of ISIS mandate under this period of time had expanded.
sentences.zh: 我们看到在此期间，ICE职责的范围扩大了。

sentences.en: We need to come in and talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我们需要进来跟你谈谈。

sentences.en: We don't all have to come in, just a couple of us, but I want to show you some pictures.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要全进来，来几个就行，但我想让你看一些照片。

sentences.en: Somebody will look towards me using this address.
sentences.zh: 有人会用这个地址看着我。

sentences.en: Oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You want to come in?
sentences.zh: 你想进来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, if you don't mind.
sentences.zh: 对，如果你不介意的话。

sentences.en: What's your name in?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Anna.
sentences.zh: 安娜。

sentences.en: Anna, OK.
sentences.zh: 安娜，好的。

sentences.en: You might have a name.
sentences.zh: 你可能有个名字。

sentences.en: How many people are in there?
sentences.zh: 里面有多少人？

sentences.en: You know, and I think these days were also when the tactic of installing fear were really at its height.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这些日子也是散布恐惧的战术真正达到顶峰的时期。

sentences.en: You know, under the previous administrations, there were specific priorities that you could only pick up a felony charge or an egregious criminal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在前几届政府任期内，有具体的优先事项，你只能抓捕重罪犯或极其严重的罪犯。

sentences.en: But now, because this idea of installing fear of, like, pushing people into the shadows, they expanded that mandate to say there are no priorities.
sentences.zh: 但现在，由于这种散布恐惧、迫使人们遁入阴影的想法，他们扩大了职责范围，声称没有优先事项。

sentences.en: If you're here illegally, we can come after you.
sentences.zh: 如果你非法呆在这里，我们就可以追捕你。

sentences.en: And I think that really put fear into communities.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实给各个社区带来了恐惧。

sentences.en: And I think they were successful at it.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们在这方面成功了。

sentences.en: OK, but I need—can I see any paperwork?
sentences.zh: 好的，但我需要——我能看一下任何文件吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'll give you a card.
sentences.zh: 好的，我给你一张卡片。

sentences.en: No, I mean, like, a paperwork saying that you guys have permission to come in here or
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，比如证明你们有权限进来的文件，或者

sentences.en: Oh, no, I have a warrant for him, and I know he lives here.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，我有针对他的搜查令，而且我知道他住在这里。

sentences.en: So that's why I'm in here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我进来的原因。

sentences.en: Plus, you open the door and let me in.
sentences.zh: 另外，你打开了门让我进来。

sentences.en: One of the more notorious examples of this fear tactic under the Trump administration was an increased focus on collaterals, which is ICE speak for undocumented people who are
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府下这种恐惧战术的更著名例子之一，是对“顺带抓获”（collaterals）的日益关注，这是ICE的行话，指的是那些

sentences.en: not the target of raids, but who agents find by accident along the way.
sentences.zh: 并非突袭目标，但特工们在行动过程中意外发现的无证移民。

sentences.en: And there's this moment where you're sort of witnessing agents adjusting to this new approach.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个时刻，你算是亲眼目睹了特工们适应这种新方法的过程。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about that?
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲那个吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think you're referring to one moment that we were in a car with an agent, and he was kind of telling us how he typically does not do collaterals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想你指的是有一次我们和一名特工坐在一辆车里，他当时在跟我们讲他通常不做“顺带抓获”。

sentences.en: I don't really—I don't do collaterals.
sentences.zh: 我真的不——我不做“顺带抓获”。

sentences.en: I just don't think it's right.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这不对。

sentences.en: He really wants to catch real criminals, his targets.
sentences.zh: 他是真的很想抓捕真正的罪犯，也就是他的目标。

sentences.en: When you're part of Fugitive Operations, you have targets of people who committed crimes, and that's who you're going after.
sentences.zh: 当你属于逃犯行动组时，你的目标是犯下罪行的人，这才是你追捕的对象。

sentences.en: I know it's my job, but I've, you know, I got guys that are aggravated felons that I'd like to catch.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是我的工作，但是，你知道，我有我想抓的严重重罪犯。

sentences.en: I don't care about the guy that's minding his own business and cooperating with me.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎那个安分守己并配合我的人。

sentences.en: And literally kind of as he was finishing to tell us that—
sentences.zh: 就在他快要把话说完的字面意思那一刻——

sentences.en: Yeah, what's up, man?
sentences.zh: 嘿，怎么了，伙计？

sentences.en: I'm going to start taking collaterals, man.
sentences.zh: 我要开始带走“顺带抓获”的人了，伙计。

sentences.en: I don't care what you do, but bring at least two people in.
sentences.zh: 我不管你做什么，但至少带两个人进来。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The supervisor came on the radio, and he's heard clearly saying, I don't care what you do, get me two people.
sentences.zh: 主管通过对讲机打来电话，清晰地听到他说，我不管你做什么，给我弄两个人来。

sentences.en: He knew you guys were with me, right?
sentences.zh: 他知道你们和我在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, because that's a pretty stupid—I'm like, I'll fit this side.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为那真是太蠢了——我心想，我来配合这边。

sentences.en: It's very clear when you see that scene and what he meant, just get me two people because they wanted to show numbers.
sentences.zh: 当你看到那个场景以及他的意思时，非常清楚，就是给我弄两个人，因为他们想要展现数据。

sentences.en: So what you were seeing here was an individual ICE agent saying that, left to my own discretion, I would like not to arrest a collateral.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这里看到的是，一个单独的ICE特工表示，如果由我自己决定，我宁愿不逮捕“顺带抓获”的人。

sentences.en: But you're kind of seeing this prevailing culture of ICE in that moment under this administration kind of winning out, because here is a boss coming on the radio
sentences.zh: 但你在这个时刻的本届政府领导下，看到这种盛行的ICE文化某种程度上占了上风，因为这里有一个老板通过对讲机打来电话，

sentences.en: and making clear that what he's interested in is just detaining people.
sentences.zh: 明确表示他关心的只是拘留人。

sentences.en: Get me people.
sentences.zh: 给我抓人。

sentences.en: Collaterals was something we saw on a daily base for years.
sentences.zh: “顺带抓获”是我们多年来每天都能看到的事情。

sentences.en: Fear will equal don't come here.
sentences.zh: 恐惧等同于别来这里。

sentences.en: Fear will equal make it as hard on them, as bad on them, maybe they will leave.
sentences.zh: 恐惧等同于给他们制造尽可能多的困难、尽可能糟糕的处境，也许他们就会离开。

sentences.en: There has been a significant increase in non-criminal arrests because we weren't allowed to arrest them in the past administration.
sentences.zh: 非刑事逮捕的数量有了显著增加，因为在上一届政府中我们不允许逮捕他们。

sentences.en: But you see more of an uptick in non-criminal because we're going from zero to 100 under the new administration.
sentences.zh: 但你会看到非刑事逮捕的上升更多，因为在新政府下，我们正从零直接飙升到一百。

sentences.en: And Tom Holman, the director of ICE at the time, basically his message was you should be scared.
sentences.zh: 当时的ICE局长汤姆·霍曼，他的核心信息基本上是你们应该感到害怕。

sentences.en: As I said earlier, if you're in this country illegally and you committed a crime by entering this country, you should be uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才所说，如果你非法身处这个国家，并且通过进入这个国家犯下了罪行，你就应该感到不安。

sentences.en: You should look over your shoulder and you need to be worried.
sentences.zh: 你该提高警惕了，真得担心起来。

sentences.en: If you're here illegally, that's the way it should be.
sentences.zh: 如果你是非法滞留在这里，那就本该如此。

sentences.en: That was part of what they were trying to put out there.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们当时试图宣扬的一部分内容。

sentences.en: And I think some did it happily and I think some did it less happily and some did it in certain moments.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得有些人做得很乐意，有些人没那么乐意，也有人在特定时刻有所纠结。

sentences.en: And I think the agents grappled with it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得特工们对此也进行过挣扎。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I do think, you know, we did see them grappling with it.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我的确觉得，你知道的，我们的确看到他们在为此纠结。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: You know, on one side, they are the ones that really know what it means when you take somebody into the system.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一方面，他们是真正清楚把一个人带进体制意味着什么的人。

sentences.en: Because a lot of times when you pick up a collateral,
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候，当你抓捕一个顺带查获的目标时，

sentences.en: their entire world begins to crumble because they get stuck in the system, whether or not they're going to be detained and deported
sentences.zh: 他们整个世界都开始崩塌，因为他们被卷入了体制之中，无论他们最终是否会被拘留和驱逐出境，

sentences.en: or they have a court case or all of these small things now come into the fold, whereas before they were just going to work minding their business.
sentences.zh: 或者他们面临诉讼，所有这些琐事现在都涌现出来，而在之前，他们本只是去上班，过着自己的日子。

sentences.en: But that deterrence equation of creating fear, of letting a story be heard, of letting people know that we're going to hold you for long times in detentions.
sentences.zh: 但那种制造恐惧、让一个故事广为人知、让人们知道我们要将你们长期关押在拘留所里的震慑逻辑，

sentences.en: That was by design.
sentences.zh: 那是刻意为之的。

sentences.en: So as we talked about, this is unfolding during the era of family separations.
sentences.zh: 所以正如我们所讨论的，这一切正是在骨肉分离的时代上演的。

sentences.en: And here, too, you captured the agents adjusting to this new reality.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你同样捕捉到了特工们适应这一新现实的过程。

sentences.en: There's this scene where you're with these agents in New York discussing the policy.
sentences.zh: 有这样一个场景，你和纽约的这些特工在一起讨论这项政策。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you can talk us through that.
sentences.zh: 我想请你给我们讲讲当时的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were in the car with Judy, an agent.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们当时和朱迪坐在一辆车里，她是一名特工。

sentences.en: We spent a long time with...
sentences.zh: 我们花了很长时间和……

sentences.en: We constantly look like we're the bad guys.
sentences.zh: 我们看起来总是像是坏人。

sentences.en: When all we're doing is enforcing the laws and doing our job.
sentences.zh: 而我们所做的不过是执行法律、履行职责。

sentences.en: And she was grappling, I think, with this idea of family separation.
sentences.zh: 我想，她当时也在纠结这种骨肉分离的想法。

sentences.en: And luckily for us, we haven't really been involved in any of that family separation thing.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说幸运的是，我们其实并没有真正参与任何那种骨肉分离的事情。

sentences.en: Being part of fugitive operations, she kind of hinted that they don't do that.
sentences.zh: 作为逃犯搜捕行动的一部分，她暗示说他们不干那种事。

sentences.en: We don't rip children out of families' arms and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把孩子从家人的怀里强行夺走之类的事情。

sentences.en: We don't do that.
sentences.zh: 我们不干那种事。

sentences.en: It's just, that's not what we do.
sentences.zh: 总之，那不是我们做的事。

sentences.en: But we proceeded to go to a house, was her, where she had actually found that target, that person that ICE was looking for.
sentences.zh: 但我们接着去了一所房子，那是她的目的地，她实际上在那里找到了那个目标，也就是移民及海关执法局（ICE）在寻找的人。

sentences.en: And she ends up arresting them, but...
sentences.zh: 她最终逮捕了他们，但是……

sentences.en: Some of the targets are parents.
sentences.zh: 有些目标是父母。

sentences.en: It's not going to be easy.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易。

sentences.en: The mother asked that the child say goodbye to the father, and she let that happen.
sentences.zh: 母亲请求让孩子和父亲道别，她允许了。

sentences.en: Listen, she wants him to say goodbye to his daughter, so...
sentences.zh: 听着，她希望他能跟女儿道别，所以……

sentences.en: And I honestly think it hurt her.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得这让她感到难受。

sentences.en: She's a parent.
sentences.zh: 她是一位母亲。

sentences.en: She's a daughter of an immigrant.
sentences.zh: 她也是个移民的女儿。

sentences.en: We always take into consideration the children and the, you know, and the family.
sentences.zh: 我们总是把孩子和……你知道的，还有家庭考虑在内。

sentences.en: And we try to make, you know, this probably unpleasant situation, you know, just a little bit easier for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们会尽量让这种本不愉快的局面，你知道的，对每个人来说都稍微好过一点。

sentences.en: But in that morning, Judy was doing exactly her mission.
sentences.zh: 但在那个早晨，朱迪正在忠实地执行她的任务。

sentences.en: And her mission was different than the systemic separation that was happening at the border at the same time.
sentences.zh: 而她的任务与当时在边境发生的系统性骨肉分离并不一样。

sentences.en: Just as a human, you have compassion towards other people.
sentences.zh: 单作为一个人，你对其他人是会有同情心的。

sentences.en: But, you know the saying, right?
sentences.zh: 但你知道那句老话，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a job, and somebody has to do it.
sentences.zh: 这就是工作，总得有人去做。

sentences.en: So, that somebody is you.
sentences.zh: 所以，那个人就是你。

sentences.en: And you just have to kind of learn how to separate, you know, your personal feelings or your personal emotions from doing your work.
sentences.zh: 你必须学会如何把你的个人感受或个人情绪，从你的工作中剥离开来。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that we have to remember a lot of these ICE agents are career officials.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我觉得我们必须记住，很多这些ICE特工都是职业官员。

sentences.en: Many of them were ICE agents under the last administration.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人在上一届政府时期就是ICE特工。

sentences.en: They're ICE agents under this administration.
sentences.zh: 他们在这一届政府时期也是ICE特工。

sentences.en: And they're going to be ICE agents under the next administration.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在下一届政府时期仍会是ICE特工。

sentences.en: The policies and the mandates do shift within whoever's in the presidential office.
sentences.zh: 政策和指令确实会随着入主白宫的人不同而发生变化。

sentences.en: And so, I think that's something to recognize is the fact that they, you know, they had different mandates under Obama.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为需要认识到的一点是，他们在奥巴马执政期间确实有不同的指令。

sentences.en: They couldn't do certain things, and they could do other things.
sentences.zh: 他们不能做某些事，但可以做其他事。

sentences.en: And then, same under Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普执政时期也是如此。

sentences.en: And I think that's something that they grapple with.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是他们所纠结的事情。

sentences.en: They are federal jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们是联邦工作岗位。

sentences.en: They are federal employees.
sentences.zh: 他们是联邦雇员。

sentences.en: They have federal positions.
sentences.zh: 他们担任着联邦职务。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, there is something to be said that maybe there are a few that say, you know what, I just can't do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，不可否认的是，也许有那么几个人会说，你知道吗，我实在干不下去了。

sentences.en: You know, I don't agree with the policies.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不同意这些政策。

sentences.en: I'm going to quit.
sentences.zh: 我要辞职。

sentences.en: But there's a lot that don't.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人并没有这么做。

sentences.en: There's a lot that just grapple with it.
sentences.zh: 很多人只是在纠结。

sentences.en: They just continue doing their job.
sentences.zh: 他们只是继续做他们的工作。

sentences.en: They do their mission.
sentences.zh: 他们执行他们的任务。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程式时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用程式，即可获得30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: So when you went to publish this film, as you said, you had to first run it by ice and they were going to put it through their various filters.
sentences.zh: 所以当你准备发布这部电影时，正如你所说，你必须先把它交由ICE审查，他们会通过各种过滤机制进行把关。

sentences.en: How did that process go?
sentences.zh: 那个过程进展得怎么样？

sentences.en: So initially we handed off the first cut to ice and about a week later we got a phone call from the spokesperson that we had been dealing with throughout the entire process of the show.
sentences.zh: 所以最初我们将第一剪的版本交给了ICE，大约一周后，我们接到了我们在整个节目制作过程中一直对接的那位发言人的电话。

sentences.en: And he immediately said, we do not like it.
sentences.zh: 他立刻说道，我们不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: This does not portray us in a favorable light.
sentences.zh: 这没有把我们描绘成正面形象。

sentences.en: In the 15 years, I've never been called up to the front office in order to talk about a series such as this.
sentences.zh: 在我这15年的经历中，我从未被叫到前台办公室去讨论过这样一个系列节目。

sentences.en: And there's things that we do not like about this and we need you to relook at some of these issues.
sentences.zh: 这里面有些东西是我们所不能接受的，你们需要重新审视其中一些问题。

sentences.en: He expressed anger that came from all the way to the top.
sentences.zh: 他表现出了来自最高层的愤怒。

sentences.en: He expressed that this is not what they expected.
sentences.zh: 他表示这并不是他们所期望的。

sentences.en: He brought up, even in that initial phone call, some stuff that legally just didn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 甚至在最初的那通电话里，他就提出了一些在法律上根本说不通的东西。

sentences.en: It didn't fall under the three, you know, things that they were allowed to come in.
sentences.zh: 这并不属于他们有权介入的三个，你知道的，那几类事情。

sentences.en: He brought stuff like the Hatch Act.
sentences.zh: 他搬出了像《哈奇法案》这样的东西。

sentences.en: That is the old rule that during Soviet times, during the Cold War, government employees cannot try and overthrow a government.
sentences.zh: 那是老掉牙的规则，在苏联时期、冷战期间，政府雇员不得试图推翻政府。

sentences.en: It didn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Oh, does he mean that he would be accused of violating the Hatch Act or that agents?
sentences.zh: 哦，他是指他会被指控违反《哈奇法案》，还是指特工们？

sentences.en: No, that agents in the episode because they were speaking about Trump.
sentences.zh: 不，是指剧集里的特工，因为他们在谈论特朗普。

sentences.en: You know, there was examples of them kind of coming back was pushback.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们有一些反击的例子，也就是推托阻挠。

sentences.en: We talked a lot about that collateral scene.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了很多关于那个顺带抓捕的场景。

sentences.en: One thing they do is use a fingerprinting machine.
sentences.zh: 他们做的一件事是使用指纹采集机。

sentences.en: And they said, well, that machine is law enforcement sensitive, something they had a right to comment about.
sentences.zh: 他们说，那台机器涉及执法敏感信息，这是他们有权发表意见的事情。

sentences.en: And so you have to take out the whole scene, which we were like, all right, take out that shot.
sentences.zh: 因此你必须删掉整个场景，而我们的反应是，好吧，删掉那个镜头。

sentences.en: But why the whole scene?
sentences.zh: 但为什么要删掉整个场景？

sentences.en: And then Christina proceeded to Google to see if anybody else had covered that.
sentences.zh: 接着克里斯蒂娜开始用谷歌搜索，看看是否其他人也报道过这个。

sentences.en: And we saw that not only that it was widely covered, that the same ICE DHS spokesman had actually put that same machine picture and wrote a story about it and send it to the press.
sentences.zh: 我们发现不仅该事件被广泛报道，而且同一个ICE国土安全部的发言人实际上还发布过那台机器的照片，并写了一篇报道发给媒体。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, you know, and once we would bring these issues, of course, they would crumble legally and try to find another.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，一旦我们抛出这些问题，他们在法律上自然就站不住脚了，于是试图找出另一个借口。

sentences.en: So there was a lot of pushback that really started to draw a quick, clear line.
sentences.zh: 因此有大量的阻挠，这真正开始划出了一条迅速而清晰的界限。

sentences.en: So they were trying to knock things out of the film?
sentences.zh: 所以他们试图把东西从电影里剔除？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But there was something that felt familiar in that mechanism of push.
sentences.zh: 但那种施压的机制中有些东西让人感觉似曾相识。

sentences.en: Familiar in the sense that you had seen it in operation on the ground in your time with the ICE agents.
sentences.zh: 这种熟悉感在于，你在和ICE特工在实地相处的过程中，已经亲眼见过它运作了。

sentences.en: Constantly.
sentences.zh: 不断的。

sentences.en: It was part of the machine that we saw.
sentences.zh: 这是我们所看到的体制的一部分。

sentences.en: We understood from the things we saw exactly what they were trying to do to get us to fold and to comply and to give up.
sentences.zh: 从我们看到的事情中，我们确切地理解了他们试图对我们做什么，好让我们屈服、妥协并放弃。

sentences.en: And I think that's something that we understood from the years of spending with them is that these tactics are something that they use.
sentences.zh: 我想这是我们在与他们相处多年后所领悟到的一点，即这些策略是他们惯用的伎俩。

sentences.en: And I'm speaking now more about leadership and not about the individual ICE agents on the ground, but how these tactics of weaponizing bureaucracy come into the fold.
sentences.zh: 我这里更多是指领导层，而不是实地基层的ICE特工，但官僚作风被武器化的这些策略是如何被引入进来的。

sentences.en: And it's not just for us, but it's for everybody.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅针对我们，而是针对所有人。

sentences.en: In some ways, it seems surprising to me that ICE would find itself surprised by what you captured and depicted in the film, right?
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，我觉得很惊讶，ICE居然会对你在电影中捕捉和描绘的内容感到意外，对吧？

sentences.en: Because on some level, it seems difficult for me to imagine that ICE wouldn't have imagined that the documentary would capture what it captured.
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，我很难想象ICE会预料不到这部纪录片拍不到它所拍下的东西。

sentences.en: The rules and the policies and these enforcement actions were not a secret.
sentences.zh: 各项规则、政策以及这些执法行动并不是什么秘密。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were surprised too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们也很惊讶。

sentences.en: You have to remember also, we started when pretty early in the Trump days, and a lot has changed in DHS.
sentences.zh: 你也得记住，我们开始拍摄时正处于特朗普执政的早期，国土安全部发生了很多变化。

sentences.en: And a lot of people who are now at the leadership have been reshuffled there.
sentences.zh: 现在处于领导层的许多人都是后来被重新调配到那里的。

sentences.en: And as in many places in this administration, but we could definitely attest to DHS, it's a little bit the yes-men that have stayed.
sentences.zh: 就像这届政府中的许多地方一样，但我们可以绝对证实国土安全部的情况是，留下来的人多少有点唯命是从。

sentences.en: And this is an election time.
sentences.zh: 而且现在正值选举时期。

sentences.en: So I think a lot came into that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多因素促成了这一点。

sentences.en: Um, and we have a very different relationship with ICE agents that we spend time with than with leadership and spokesmen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们和共处过的ICE特工的关系，与我们和领导层及发言人的关系有着很大不同。

sentences.en: And they had a very different reaction to the show they ultimately saw on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 他们对最终在网飞上看到的节目的反应截然不同。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: What was their reaction?
sentences.zh: 他们的反应是什么？

sentences.en: This is mainly the individuals that we were fairly close to throughout the production and that we've kind of stayed close to.
sentences.zh: 这主要是指那些我们在整个制作过程中关系相当密切、并且一直保持联系的个人。

sentences.en: Those ones, you know, came back and some of them liked what they saw.
sentences.zh: 这些人呢，回过头来看，其中一些人喜欢他们看到的内容。

sentences.en: Others didn't like what they saw.
sentences.zh: 其他人则不喜欢他们看到的内容。

sentences.en: It was a, it was quite a variety.
sentences.zh: 反应可以说是五花八门。

sentences.en: But I think they understood that we did profile what we saw day to day and what they do day to day.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们理解我们确实如实记录了我们日常所见以及他们日常所做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, we had, we had an officer who told us in the show.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在节目中有一位警官告诉我们。

sentences.en: You know, it's an unfortunate situation because a lot of these guys are hardworking individuals.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是一种不幸的处境，因为许多这些家伙都是勤劳的人。

sentences.en: That he understands the people he's arresting.
sentences.zh: 他理解他正在逮捕的人。

sentences.en: And maybe it's hard for him because he would do exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 也许这对他来说很难，因为他自己也会做出完全相同的选择。

sentences.en: They're here to work and provide for their family.
sentences.zh: 他们来这里是为了工作并养家糊口。

sentences.en: They just get caught up in politics if you look at it.
sentences.zh: 如果你从这个角度看，他们只是被卷入了政治漩涡。

sentences.en: That's how it is.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: And when we checked into it with him after the show had been published, we kind of asked, hey, how was the portrayal?
sentences.zh: 节目播出后，我们在他回访时跟他沟通，我们大概问了问，嘿，人物塑造得怎么样？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: He's like, no, it was fine.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，挺好的。

sentences.en: This was the real world.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实世界。

sentences.en: But that line wasn't so good for me.
sentences.zh: 但那句台词对我来说不太好。

sentences.en: And I said, why?
sentences.zh: 我问为什么？

sentences.en: You're showing empathy.
sentences.zh: 你展现出了同理心。

sentences.en: And he's like, yeah, but empathy in these days could be looked as you're not supporting the mission.
sentences.zh: 他说，对，但在如今这个年代，同理心可能会被视为你不支持这项任务。

sentences.en: Yeah, that one really, we didn't see that one coming.
sentences.zh: 是的，那句话确实，我们完全没料到会这样。

sentences.en: I mean, it's that this attitude that in our minds, we were putting this individual in a place where he was having compassion and empathy towards those that he detains.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这种态度是，在我们的心目中，我们把这个人塑造成了一个对被拘留者抱有同情和同理心的形象。

sentences.en: And in his mind, he was not supporting the mission.
sentences.zh: 而在他的心目中，他却是在不支持任务。

sentences.en: But I could see what he meant.
sentences.zh: 但我能理解他的意思。

sentences.en: And I think that surprised us.
sentences.zh: 我想这确实让我们感到意外。

sentences.en: Well, we were gratified as most agents felt that we portrayed the world as it exists.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们感到很欣慰，因为大多数经纪人都觉得我们展现了真实的世界。

sentences.en: And certainly it's not, it's not easy to always look in the mirror, but it was a very, very, very different reaction than we anticipated.
sentences.zh: 当然，照镜子从来都不是一件容易的事，但这与我们预期的反应截然不同，完全不同。

sentences.en: Well, Christina and Shaul, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，克里斯蒂娜和沙ul，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: ICE has disputed Shaul and Christina's account of efforts to block the film Immigration Nation from being released until after the election.
sentences.zh: 美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）对沙ul和克里斯蒂娜关于阻止纪录片《移民国度》在大选前上映的努力的说法提出了异议。

sentences.en: In a statement to the Times, the agency said, quote,
sentences.zh: 该机构在给《时报》的一份声明中表示：

sentences.en: The men and women of ICE perform outstanding work daily that often goes unnoticed or is misrepresented to the point of falsehood.
sentences.zh: ICE的全体男女员工每天都在进行着出色的工作，这些工作往往被忽视，或者被歪曲到失真的地步。

sentences.en: ICE, the statement continued, is firmly committed to carrying out the agency's sworn duty to enforce federal law as passed by Congress professionally, consistently,
sentences.zh: 声明接着说，ICE坚定地致力于履行机构的宣誓职责，以专业、一致的方式执行国会通过的联邦法律，

sentences.en: and in full compliance with federal law and agency policies.
sentences.zh: 并完全遵守联邦法律和机构政策。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: It is apocalyptic.
sentences.zh: 这简直是末日般的景象。

sentences.en: I drove 600 miles up and down the state.
sentences.zh: 我在这州上下开了六百英里车。

sentences.en: I never escaped the smoke.
sentences.zh: 我从未逃脱烟雾。

sentences.en: We have thousands of people who have lost their homes.
sentences.zh: 我们有成千上万的人失去了家园。

sentences.en: I could never have envisioned this.
sentences.zh: 我绝不可能想象到这一点。

sentences.en: At least 25 people have died from the wildfires in California, Washington, and Oregon, where the fires have now consumed more than one million acres.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州和俄勒冈州的野火已造成至少25人死亡，这些大火目前已吞噬了超过一百万英亩的土地。

sentences.en: The east winds came over the top of the mountain, proceeded to turn the fires into blow torches that went down
sentences.zh: 东风翻越山顶，将大火变成喷灯，向下席卷，

sentences.en: and just incinerated a series of small towns like Blue River and Phoenix and Talent.
sentences.zh: 将蓝河、菲尼克斯和塔伦特等一系列小镇化为灰烬。

sentences.en: In an interview with ABC News on Sunday, Oregon Senator Jeff Merkley blamed the fires on decades' worth of climate change.
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州参议员杰夫·默克利周日接受美国广播公司新闻网采访时，将火灾归咎于几十年来气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: I've seen somebody just walk up and just start shooting on them.
sentences.zh: 我看到有人直接走过去就开始向他们开枪。

sentences.en: It pisses me off.
sentences.zh: 这真让我火大。

sentences.en: It dismays me at the same time.
sentences.zh: 与此同时我也感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: And there's no prettier way to say it.
sentences.zh: 而且这话没法说得更好听了。

sentences.en: Authorities in Los Angeles are investigating what they said was the unprovoked shooting over the weekend
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶当局正在调查他们所说的周末无端枪击事件，

sentences.en: of two sheriff's deputies sitting in their patrol car in an incident caught on surveillance tape.
sentences.zh: 当时两名副警长坐在巡逻车里，这一事件被监控录像拍了下来。

sentences.en: The officers remain in critical condition, and the shooter remains at large.
sentences.zh: 警官们仍然处于危急状态，枪手仍然在逃。

sentences.en: But Los Angeles Sheriff Alex Villanueva suggested that the ambush was linked to rising antipathy toward police.
sentences.zh: 但洛杉矶县警长亚历克斯·维拉纽瓦暗示，这起伏击事件与对警察日益增长的敌意有关。

sentences.en: This is just a sober reminder that this is a dangerous job, and, you know, actions, words have consequences,
sentences.zh: 这只是一个清醒的提醒，这是一项危险的工作，而且，你知道的，行动和言语都会带来后果，

sentences.en: and our job does not get any easier because people don't like law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 由于人们不喜欢执法部门，我们的工作并没有变得更容易。

sentences.en: It's going to be a challenge day after day.
sentences.zh: 这将是日复一日的挑战。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: My colleague, Megan Tuohy, will host tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我的同事梅根·图希将主持明天的节目。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《导购之星》节目中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线很敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是一躺下就能睡着那种。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《导购之星》。
